narrative: Chart of Accounts administration — the Aktia planning COA maps the group ledger (Oracle / Snowflake) across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped ledger accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard banking lines such as interest income, commission income and credit losses.

signals.excerpt: Active ledger accounts mapped to planning leaf accounts; a small number of legacy life insurance codes are under review with the system replacement.
